subject: O Level Physics
title: Water gun
question:
Fig. 5.1 shows a water gun that makes use of pressure exerted on a trigger to spray water out of a nozzle. The nozzle is initially covered with a stopper.
(a) The cross-sectional areas of the piston and nozzle are 2.0 cm² and 0.080 cm² respectively. If a force of 5.0 N is exerted on the trigger, calculate the force exerted on the water leaving the nozzle.
(b)(i) When the force of 5.0 N is applied, the piston moves 0.60 cm in one second. Calculate the work done by the 5.0 N force on the water.
referenceNote: The original figure from the physics paper.
